description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractServiceBase' for services that can bind to secure and/or non-secure ports, managing configuration, SSL/TLS setup, health checks, and lifecycle methods.

classes.name: AbstractServiceBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for services binding to secure and/or insecure ports, including configuration, SSL/TLS setup, health checks, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: setTracer
methods.description: Sets the OpenTracing tracer; defaults to a no-op tracer if not provided.

methods.name: setHealthCheckServer
methods.description: Sets the health check server instance.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the component, registering health check resources and invoking startInternal.

methods.name: startInternal
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform startup tasks; defaults to succeeded future.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the component, invoking stopInternal.

methods.name: stopInternal
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform shutdown tasks; defaults to succeeded future.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Registers readiness checks; default empty implementation.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Registers liveness checks; default empty implementation.

methods.name: getPortDefaultValue
methods.description: Abstract method to get default secure port number.

methods.name: getInsecurePortDefaultValue
methods.description: Abstract method to get default insecure port number.

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Abstract method to get current secure port if listening.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Abstract method to get current insecure port if listening.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the effective secure port, considering actual listening port, configuration, or unconfigured constant.

methods.name: getInsecurePort
methods.description: Returns the effective insecure port, considering actual listening port, configuration, or unconfigured constant.

methods.name: checkPortConfiguration
methods.description: Verifies proper port and certificate configuration before startup.

methods.name: determineSecurePort
methods.description: Determines the secure port to bind based on configuration.

methods.name: determineInsecurePort
methods.description: Determines the insecure port to bind based on configuration.

methods.name: isSecurePortEnabled
methods.description: Checks if secure port is configured with key/cert options.

methods.name: isInsecurePortEnabled
methods.description: Checks if insecure port is enabled in configuration.

methods.name: getBindAddress
methods.description: Returns the bind address for secure port.

methods.name: getInsecurePortBindAddress
methods.description: Returns the bind address for insecure port.

methods.name: addTlsTrustOptions
methods.description: Adds trust options to server configuration if SSL is enabled and trust options are not set.

methods.name: getServerTrustOptions
methods.description: Returns trust options for server; default from configuration.

methods.name: addTlsKeyCertOptions
methods.description: Adds key/cert options to server configuration, enables SSL, and configures protocols, using OpenSSL if available.
